title: Chapter 199 Zhao Guo'S Great Rise
content:
Chapter 199 Zhao Guo'S Great Rise

South Korea can't continue fighting now, and the 200,000 troops hastily mobilized by Qin Wang Yingzheng is already the limit he can reach.

Among them, the previous 100,000 is the only mobile force that Qin can mobilize, and it is ready to be sent out at any time.

Usually, the main function of this army is to deal with the wars of various countries. For example, if any country has any flaws, natural disasters, man-made disasters, and internal turmoil, this army can take a bite of the opportunity and bite off a piece of fat for Qin. The meat comes.

Or it was used by the Qin State to quell various internal problems, for example, sit in the center to deter everywhere, warn those with ulterior motives, and let them hide in the dark obediently and dare not move.

Or there is an emergency in the frontier, and there are 100,000 people who can rush to support at any time. An army of 100,000, even if the enemy has millions, can last for a few days, buying enough time for Qin to prepare.

All in all, these 100,000 troops are Qin's Dinghaishenzhen and firefighters, which were specially reserved.

Now it will come in handy, 100,000 people are sent to South Korea, intending to fight this young bird first, as South Korea is the first country to join the alliance, its own strength is extremely weak, if Qin does not fight him, who should be hit?

Therefore, based on Qin's past experience, if the 100,000 troops are properly dealt with, it is still possible to win South Korea with the fighting will and fighting power that South Korea has shown in the past.

Considering the special situation now, King Qin sent him another 100,000 troops to support him. In Ying Zheng's heart, with this 200,000 troops, with the bravery of Qin's army of tigers and wolves, it is not easy to win the weak Han. .

In fact, not only Qin, but also other countries think so, so Wei Guo obviously has an army of 150,000, but they all gather in the capital to protect the safety of King Wei, and refuse to send rescue to South Korea at all.

Doesn't Wei Guo know that South Korea is destroyed, so Wei Guo has to bear the pressure from Qin State alone?

He knew, but he was afraid of Qin and distrusted South Korea's strength, so he hesitated and kept a wait-and-see attitude.

But what surprised Qin and other countries was that South Korea's determination to resist this time was so strong.

Not only did King Han change his previous cowardly character, but the ministers in South Korea also changed their fatuous and greedy nature, and they became so bloody and spineless that they vowed to resist Qin's attack to the death, and forcibly defended South Korea. .

This fact boosted the morale of the Six Nations. They believed that the weakest country like South Korea, whose national power was less than half of Wei's today, could withstand the hot pursuit of Qin's 200,000 troops.

As a big country like Wei and Zhao whose national power far surpasses that of South Korea, why should they be afraid of Qin?

A South Korea can hold back Qin's 200,000 troops and wear them down deeply. What about Zhao and Wei? How many people in Qin State do they use energy?

I'm afraid Qin Guo can't take it out, as long as they can resist to the death and finish the rest with the country!

Therefore, the morale of the six countries in Shandong is extremely high now. Even a cowardly and cowardly existence like Wei State dares to take the initiative to send troops, coveting the lonely land of Qin State in the six countries of Shandong.

After hearing the news that South Korea had defended Xinzheng City, Zhao Guo's actions were also extremely fast.

He quickly mobilized his army, a total of 150,000, which was the number that King Zhao had promised to send troops, and hurriedly drove to the painful place of Zhao State, that is, Shangdang.

As an important place to separate Zhao and Qin, Shangdang shoulders a heavy responsibility. Not only does it have the natural danger of this pass, but it also completely separates Qin from Zhao because of the geographical advantage of the Taihang Mountains.

And the most important thing is that the 100,000 troops stationed in Qin State in Shangdang are fully twice the 50,000 defenders in other counties.

This amount of troops, with the help of natural dangers, is enough to suffocate any army of the Six Nations.

With Zhao Guo's 150,000 troops, it is absolutely idiotic to want to break through a pass and take down Shangdang. Let alone the Qin people don't believe it, even the Zhao people don't believe it.

Therefore, although King Zhao's final goal was Shangdang County, his marching strategy was not to attack Shangdang directly.

His first target was Taiyuan County in the north of Shangdang.

Taiyuan County, as the old nest of Zhao State, has been operating for an unknown period of time. It was only after occupying the hinterland of the Central Plains, which is now HD County, that it slowly shifted its focus.

But even so, Taiyuan County is also the second largest center of care, and it is also a place with a large population.

Here is the deep business foundation of Zhao State. If King Zhao sends troops to attack Taiyuan County, it will be much smoother, and many people in Taiyuan County who have Zhao State in their hearts will accept it from their hearts, and there will be no obstacles to rule.

After all, it has only been more than ten years since Taiyuan left the State of Zhao. Whether it is the old generation or the new generation, they still miss the State of Zhao very much.

Although the Qin law guaranteed the interests of the people to some extent, it was still too strict. The people of the six countries who were used to freedom and looseness could not be turned into parts of a machine, and went to the Qin country neatly and tightly. This war machine doesn't have decades of adaptation and integration, so don't even think about it.

Therefore, when Yu Guo's army had just arrived in Wei State, King Zhao's 150,000 troops had already reached the border of Taiyuan County.

When I first heard that soldiers and horses from my motherland had come to Taiyuan County, the people in the whole county were overjoyed, but because of Qin's strict laws and the 50,000 garrisoned troops.

The people in Taiyuan still dare not show it on their faces, they just celebrate a little in their hearts and at home, and pass some words in private.

However, an undercurrent has already surged, and even the 50,000 Qin army who lived with them have noticed it.

While sending most of the army to resist Zhao's 150,000 army, 10,000 people were left behind, and military control was implemented everywhere to closely monitor the old Zhao people in Taiyuan.

The battle in Taiyuan County went smoothly. Although the Qin people's army was very powerful, Zhao Guo, which was also famous for attacking the grassland people and plundering their living places, was not inferior in the slightest.

After Zhao State was able to reform with Qin State, they competed with each other for nearly 50 years and became the first barrier for the six Kanto countries to resist Qin State. This is a clear proof.

The 150,000 Zhao army, with the support of the local people in Taiyuan County, and the secret support of the tyrants from all over the country, under the cooperation of the inside and the outside, although the Qin army is brave, it still cannot stop the backstabbing.

In three days, the border defense of Taiyuan County was broken, and without too much loss, Zhao Jun drove straight in and broke into the interior of Taiyuan County.
